tactics:
induction xs generalizing i with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases i with
    | zero => simp
    | succ i =>
      simp only [List.drop_succ_cons]
      rw [ih]
      simp only [Nat.add_right_comm i 1 j, List.getElem_cons_succ]
induction xs generalizing i <;> cases i <;> simp_all [Nat.add_right_comm]
